mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_email, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, user_status FROM users WHERE user_status != 'DELETED'

SELECT user_id, user_email, user_pwd, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, user_status, email_verified, ticket_count, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS created_at FROM users WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND user_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT user_id, user_email, user_pwd, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, user_status, email_verified, ticket_count, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS created_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_email, user_pwd, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, email_verified, ticket_count) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{userPwd}, #{userName}, #{userPhone}, #{userProfileImg}, #{emailVerified}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_status = 'DELETED', user_email = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id, '_', user_email) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET ticket_count = ticket_count + #{tickets} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET ticket_count = ticket_count - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ticket_count > 0
